name: roman_value
description: Convert Roman numerals I through XX to decimal numbers, with matched controls copying an Arabic tag.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
 result=''
 for value,symbol in [(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]:
  q,n=divmod(n,value);result+=symbol*q
 return result
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
 n=random.randrange(1,21);tag=random.randrange(1,21)
 prefix=f'Roman numeral: {roman(n)}. Tag: {tag}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'The Roman numeral in decimal is:', 'answer':' '+str(n)})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'The tag in decimal is:', 'answer':' '+str(tag)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
